dedupe_keys.name: aircraft movements by class of operation airports with nav canada services and other selected airports monthly

description: Twelve Statistics Canada CSV table members report aircraft movements by class of operation, civil or military status and airport control-service category. Monthly tables distinguish itinerant and local movements; selected tables include peak hour, peak day or commercial/private operations. Annual companions cover airports with NAV CANADA towers or flight-service stations and airports without control towers. Their native periods differ: older series begin in 1997 and end between 2018 and 2022, while broader selected-airport monthly tables start in 2019 or 2022 and end in January 2023. Tables are grouped as related movement statistics, with each exact PID retained and no assumption of uninterrupted continuity or identical airport populations. One tower monthly table says Other (Not Open) despite an open access label; this licence conflict remains unresolved. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves source identifiers and descriptive metadata. Provider: Stats Canada. Licence: Other (Open); Other (Not Open); conflicting source classifications retained. Costs and current file access are unverified. Access metadata says Open; isopen is true. No linked dataset, workbook, document, archive or model/code body was retrieved. Specific simulation applications beyond the stated role are unknown. Related source components retain their own identities.
